title: 北海道大學ISP獎助：2027年入學金與首學期學費減免
Hokkaido ISP support: enrollment and first-semester tuition waivers for 2027
description: 台灣高中生符合非日本籍、非日本永住與學歷英語條件可申請；11月20日17:00日本時間截止，後續年度減免須再遴選。

Eligible Taiwanese applicants without Japanese citizenship or permanent residence may apply, subject to education and English requirements. Applications close at 17:00 JST on 20 November; later fee waivers require selection.
funding: 入學金全免及首學期學費全免；後續減免須遴選
Enrollment fee and first-semester tuition waived; later waivers are selective

JASSO Study in Japan｜ISP入學金減免資料

paragraphs: 北海道大學2027年ISP招生簡章明列：2027年10月入學的本科生可免入學金及首學期學費。簡章所列入學金為282,000日圓、年學費535,800日圓，校方保留調整費額權利。後續學費減免每年遴選，可減免半年或一年，並非人人續領；不能宣傳為整個學位免費，也不包含生活費。

Hokkaido's 2027 ISP guidelines waive the enrollment fee and first-semester tuition for October 2027 undergraduate entrants. Listed fees are ¥282,000 for enrollment and ¥535,800 per year, subject to revision. Subsequent waivers are selected annually for half or a full year and are not awarded to everyone. This is not a free entire degree or a living allowance.
台灣學生須符合日本以外12年正式學校教育等認可資格，並按簡章符合連續在校年數及英語要求；具日本國籍或日本永住身分者不能申請。課程以理科為核心，仍須準備學術成績、推薦信與所需測驗資料，並經甄選。國籍符合不等於自動錄取，這項減免也不適用所有北海道大學課程。

Taiwanese candidates must satisfy an accepted qualification such as 12 years of formal schooling outside Japan, the required continuous-schooling period and English requirements. Japanese citizens and permanent residents are ineligible. The science-focused programme requires academic records, a recommendation and applicable test evidence and uses selection. Eligible nationality is not automatic admission, and the waiver does not cover every Hokkaido course.
## 網路送件與推薦信有不同期限
## Online submission and recommendation deadlines differ
2027年入學本輪已於11月12日開放，網路申請至2026年11月20日17:00日本時間，即台北16:00。推薦信需由推薦人於同一截止前寄出，並在12月4日17:00日本時間前送達；網路申請需要填入追蹤號碼。12月4日不是可以延後網路申請的日期，應提前和推薦人安排。

The 2027-entry round opened on 12 November. Online applications close at 17:00 JST on 20 November 2026, equivalent to 16:00 in Taipei. The referee must dispatch the recommendation by that deadline for arrival by 17:00 JST on 4 December, and its tracking number is needed in the online application. The December date does not extend online registration; coordinate with the referee early.
11月15日實讀2027簡章與申請時程，並以日本學生支援機構的Study in Japan資料庫交叉檢視入學金、首學期減免及續領限制。該資料庫紀錄更新於2024年，只作制度背景，不能用來證明2027開放；當期開放與適用年度以2027簡章及申請頁確認。校方一般Fees頁仍寫2026梯次，故本頁不把那份舊文字冒充2027規定。

On 15 November we read the 2027 guidelines and application schedule and cross-checked the enrollment waiver, first-semester support and renewal limits against JASSO's Study in Japan database. Those database records were updated in 2024 and provide background, not proof of the 2027 opening. Current eligibility and timing come from the 2027 documents. The university's general Fees page still describes the 2026 intake, so we do not present it as the 2027 rules.
入學金與首學期學費在雷達合併為一個ISP獎助方案，不拆成兩筆新增。簡章另提及可能的日本政府推薦獎學金，須先獲計畫採納並經選拔，不能視為本項已保證的生活津貼。家庭應另外準備後續未獲減免時的完整學費與生活預算。

The enrollment and first-semester waivers are counted as one ISP support scheme in the radar, not two new awards. The guidelines separately mention a possible government-nominated scholarship requiring programme approval and selection; it is not a guaranteed living allowance under this listing. Families should budget for living costs and later tuition if a further waiver is not awarded.
